gui.starbridge.install.runtime_inactive: Retrofit is loaded. Finish setting up its legacy runtime at the title screen, then restart the game. Keep one copy of each legacy mod.
gui.starbridge.install.help.waiting: Set up the runtime to check this component.
gui.starbridge.install.help.unknown: The client could not read the load state. Check the file and folder above, then restart.
gui.starbridge.install.title: Flight setup
gui.starbridge.install.local: Select a component to see its role and where it belongs on this client.
gui.starbridge.install.help.missing: Quit the game, put this file in the folder above, then restart. On multiplayer, ask the host to check the server too.
gui.starbridge.install.help.loaded: Detected on this client. The filename above is the one used by this pack. On multiplayer, check the server too.
gui.starbridge.install.yard_missing: Missing original shipyard blocks. Check their folders below.
gui.starbridge.install.use.starbridge: Adds the navigation slate, helm and orbital flight controls.
gui.starbridge.install.use.retrofit: Starts the legacy mods inside Forge 1.20.1. Follow the Retrofit prompt on the title screen to set up its runtime.
gui.starbridge.install.use.dock: Connects ships built in the original assembler to Starbridge flight. Install it on the legacy side.
gui.starbridge.install.use.advancedrocke: Supplies the pad, tower, assembler and original rockets. Build your hull on the launch pad.
gui.starbridge.install.use.libvulpes: Provides blocks, materials and machinery used by Advanced Rocketry.
gui.starbridge.install.use.galacticraft: Provides the original Moon, Mars, dungeons, bosses and loot. Core, Planets and MicdoodleCore come in this single file.
gui.starbridge.install.use.valkyrienskie: Moves your block-built ship under local physics when approaching and landing.
gui.starbridge.install.use.kotlinforforg: Supplies the Kotlin runtime required by Valkyrien Skies.
gui.starbridge.install.use.extraplanets: Adds the original ExtraPlanets destinations and technology progression.
gui.starbridge.install.use.galaxyspace: Adds GalaxySpace worlds and space gear. Use the pack’s coexistence settings when both planet expansions are installed.
gui.starbridge.install.use.computercraft: Lets the shipowner pair an in-game computer at the helm and authorize it to fly.
advancements.starbridge.first_flight.roo: Make a compass to unlock the Navigation Slate recipe at a crafting table. Hover over the compass to see the next step.
advancements.starbridge.first_flight.com: Once you have a compass, search the crafting table recipe book for Navigation Slate to see its ingredients.
advancements.starbridge.first_flight.sla: Aim at empty space with the slate in hand. Press %s to open First flight, then choose Build a shipyard.
message.starbridge.not_owner: Only the ship owner or an operator can control this core.
message.starbridge.core_selected: Open the flight deck to select a destination or take control.
message.starbridge.slate_bind: Use the navigation slate on your flight deck to pair it.
message.starbridge.moon_charted: Moon chart complete. Its flight path is now stored in your navigation slate.
message.starbridge.vent_charge: Cabin oxygen: %s person-seconds. Use an oxygen canister to refill.
message.starbridge.voyage_begun: Course set for %s. The arrival procedure is underway.
message.starbridge.voyage_arrived: Arrived at %s. The ship is berthed.
campaign.starbridge.arrival.moon: Seal two lunar samples with core tubes, then bring them home to craft a lunar reference chart.
campaign.starbridge.arrival.mars: Archive signal at %s, %s, %s. Expose the carved stone and use a sample tube to take a rubbing.
campaign.starbridge.arrival.belt: Wreck signal at %s, %s, %s. Use a sample tube on the copper recorder. Rescue orders target the blue-ice capsule four blocks east.
campaign.starbridge.arrival.relay: Anchor at %s, %s, %s. Place your relay terminal above the carved foundation and deliver antenna sections, copper and redstone blocks.
campaign.starbridge.no_site: No clear expedition site near this berth. Clear the approach between X 0–32 and Z 32–64, then return.
campaign.starbridge.home_calibration: Calibrate this chart in the Overworld after your return.
campaign.starbridge.calibrated.1: Mars and asteroid-belt routes calibrated. Return with two archive rubbings or flight recorders for the deep space chart.
campaign.starbridge.calibrated.2: Deep space route calibrated. Take a relay terminal, 3 antenna sections, 32 copper ingots and 8 redstone blocks to the anchor.
campaign.starbridge.tube_help: Use a tube on lunar rock, a Martian archive engraving, a wreck recorder or a contracted rescue pod.
campaign.starbridge.inventory_full: Make room for the shipment in your inventory.
campaign.starbridge.wrong_site: Install the terminal above the marked foundation at the deep space relay.
campaign.starbridge.materials: Deliver to terminal: antenna sections %s/%s, copper ingots %s/%s, redstone blocks %s/%s.
campaign.starbridge.online: %s brought the deep space relay online. Dispatch is accepting shipments.
campaign.starbridge.order.supply: Supply run: deliver 16 bread together to provision the relief crew. Payout: 4 emeralds.
campaign.starbridge.order.survey: Survey run: deliver one archive rubbing from the Martian dig. Payout: 4 emeralds.
campaign.starbridge.order.rescue: Rescue run: take a sample tube to the blue-ice escape pod at the belt wreck. Bring the occupied capsule here. Payout: 6 emeralds.
campaign.starbridge.adv.samples.title: Cargo from the Moon
campaign.starbridge.adv.samples.desc: Collect a physical lunar core sample.
campaign.starbridge.adv.chart.title: The Next Two Horizons
campaign.starbridge.adv.chart.desc: Return with lunar material and craft a chart. Use it at home to enable Mars and the belt.
campaign.starbridge.adv.deep.title: Fix on the Dark
campaign.starbridge.adv.deep.desc: Combine Mars or belt records into a deep space chart and calibrate it at home.
campaign.starbridge.adv.online.title: A Light in Deep Space
campaign.starbridge.adv.online.desc: Take part in a working relay station at the deep-space anchor.
campaign.starbridge.adv.dispatch.title: First Relief Flight
campaign.starbridge.adv.dispatch.desc: Deliver a shipment ordered by the deep space relay.
campaign.starbridge.wrong_rescue_order: This capsule belongs to a previous relief flight. Recover the crew for the current dispatch at the belt.
nav.starbridge.title: Flight deck
nav.starbridge.lift.loading: Preparing the entire ship for takeoff. Stay on deck. Your selected course will start automatically.
nav.starbridge.lift.busy: Another pilot is preparing this ship for takeoff.
nav.starbridge.lift.timeout: The whole ship could not be loaded. Choose the destination again to retry.
nav.starbridge.lift.changed: The ship or crew changed during preparation. Board the ship and choose your destination again.
nav.starbridge.devices.title: Connected ship computers
nav.starbridge.devices.empty: Connect a powered CC:Tweaked computer to the helm, then refresh.
nav.starbridge.devices.missing: Install CC:Tweaked to connect a ship computer.
nav.starbridge.devices.gone: That computer disconnected. Reconnect it and refresh the list.
nav.starbridge.state.ready: Ready for departure. Choose how to fly.
nav.starbridge.state.current: Your current port. Select another body.
nav.starbridge.state.missing_world: The server has no matching Galacticraft world. Install and enable its original world provider.
nav.starbridge.state.unknown_port: Start at Earth or an original registered destination.
nav.starbridge.state.assembly: Build and launch this ship with the Advanced Rocketry assembler.
nav.starbridge.proof.gate: Open Navigation calibration below to choose a schematic or rocket for this destination.
nav.starbridge.proof.find_rocket: Build this rocket at its original NASA workbench. The helm can read it from your inventory.
nav.starbridge.proof.find_ceres: A tier 4 schematic can turn up in an original ExtraPlanets Ceres dungeon chest. Chest rewards vary.
nav.starbridge.proof.find_schematic: Look for rocket schematics in original dungeon rewards. A completed rocket of sufficient tier also works.
nav.starbridge.proof.title: Navigation calibration
nav.starbridge.proof.instructions: Bring a listed item aboard and select it to calibrate. You keep the item.
nav.starbridge.proof.none: This world has no registered navigation item for the required tier.
nav.starbridge.proof.known: This helm already meets the route requirement (tier %s).
nav.starbridge.proof.changed: The item in that slot changed. Select a matching item in your inventory.
nav.starbridge.proof.return: Approach this helm or board its ship to calibrate.
nav.starbridge.proof.unknown: The original destination is unavailable. Return to the chart.
nav.starbridge.state.technology: Use the original tier schematic or rocket on this console to calibrate navigation.
nav.starbridge.state.fuel: Charge the drive with fuel or FE. Set aside enough energy for the return leg.
nav.starbridge.kit.title: Lunar EVA gear
nav.starbridge.kit.open.missing: Galacticraft oxygen equipment is not installed in this world.
nav.starbridge.kit.open.busy: Put down the item on your cursor and close any other container, then try again.
nav.starbridge.kit.open.unavailable: The Galacticraft equipment inventory is unavailable. Try again shortly.
nav.starbridge.kit.rations.title: Field rations
nav.starbridge.kit.rations.outdoors: Eat these rations outdoors on the Moon. With GalaxySpace installed, ordinary baked potatoes need a breathable atmosphere.
nav.starbridge.kit.rations.use: Keep a can in your hotbar to eat during a surface walk.
nav.starbridge.kit.rations.no_recipe: This world does not list a crafting table recipe for this ration.
nav.starbridge.kit.oxygen_help: Fit the mask, oxygen gear and two filled tanks in your Galacticraft equipment slots. Check the tanks before going outside.
nav.starbridge.kit.radiation_help: Wear all four GalaxySpace suit pieces. Apply an airtight seal to each in the Advanced Rocketry chemical reactor. Sunlight can reach an open deck.
nav.starbridge.kit.pressure_help: Wear the full suit. Fit a pressure tank in the chest piece and fill it with oxygen before entering vacuum.
slate.starbridge.guide.title: First flight
slate.starbridge.guide.recipe_help: Arrange the ingredients on a crafting table. Place the helm aboard your ship, then link your chart terminal to it.
slate.starbridge.guide.recipe_unavailabl: This world does not supply a shaped helm recipe for this display. Check your modpack’s recipes.
slate.starbridge.guide.missing: The Advanced Rocketry shipyard blocks are unavailable in this world. The original assembler requires Advanced Rocketry and LibVulpes.
slate.starbridge.guide.plan_help: Fill a 3×3 pad. Build the tower just outside its left edge. Face the assembler screen away from the pad. Press %s on it to inspect the hull.
slate.starbridge.guide.elevation_help: Seen from the screen, the tower is six blocks high from the base. Put the assembler one block above pad level. Press %s on it to inspect the hull.
slate.starbridge.guide.bind_help: Hold the chart terminal and press %s on a helm console you placed. Use the linked terminal again to open your ship’s chart.
slate.starbridge.guide.hint: Use to open the star chart. An unlinked terminal shows how to build a shipyard and link the helm.
surface.starbridge.title: Surface helm
surface.starbridge.description: Translation thrust · fly clear of terrain
surface.starbridge.surface_detail: Terrain below the hull center. The bow or stern may be closer to the surface. Negative speed means descent. XYZ %s
surface.starbridge.hint: Move %s / %s / %s / %s   Rise %s   Descend %s   Hold %s to look
nav.starbridge.state.settling: Securing the previous arrival. Stay aboard while the ship checks cargo and settles the fare. The chart will update automatically.
vent.starbridge.title: Cabin oxygen
vent.starbridge.empty: Your compartment is sealed. Load a canister to start supplying oxygen.
vent.starbridge.open: Your position is outside the sealed compartment. Close the hatch or seal gaps around the vent.
surface.starbridge.status.launching: Lifting off. Brake to return the ship to its berth.
surface.starbridge.status.docked: Docked. Open Ship systems and choose Surface helm to lift off.
surface.starbridge.status.already_flying: The ship is flying. Use Hold or Brake at the helm.
surface.starbridge.status.cancelled: Launch cancelled. The ship is docked.
surface.starbridge.status.timeout: Lift-off timed out. The ship is docked. Choose Surface helm to retry.
surface.starbridge.status.fuel: Connect Forge Energy or use furnace fuel on the helm console.
surface.starbridge.status.occupied: Another pilot is at this helm.
slate.starbridge.materials.workshop_hint: Select an ingredient to see how to make it.
slate.starbridge.materials.press_help_of: Place obsidian on the bottom, a tin block above it and the press on top. Attach a lever to the side of the press.
slate.starbridge.materials.press_help_on: Switch on the lever and collect four tin plates. Switch it off before inserting the next tin block.
slate.starbridge.materials.title: Parts and recipes
slate.starbridge.materials.ingredients: Select an ingredient to trace its recipe. Top-row counts include the ship and its launch pad.
slate.starbridge.materials.missing: This world has no such original block. Check that Advanced Rocketry and LibVulpes are loaded.
slate.starbridge.materials.outside_table: There is no workbench, cooking or stonecutting recipe for this item. Look for it in the world or in an original mod machine.
slate.starbridge.field.title: Surface survey
slate.starbridge.field.shortcut: Hold %s and press %s to open the surface survey.
slate.starbridge.field.hold: Hold a chart terminal to use its field notes.
slate.starbridge.field.replace: Click again to replace the original %s marker with your current position.
slate.starbridge.field.clues.title: Terrain key
slate.starbridge.field.clues.bowl_help: Orange cells can be craters or ravines. Follow the gradual slopes on the map.
slate.starbridge.field.clues.shaft_help: A gold rim marks a sharp drop inside one cell. Look over the edge from stable ground.
slate.starbridge.field.clues.moon: On the Galacticraft Moon, look into the opening for worked bricks and a passage. Mark the entrance once you see the masonry.
slate.starbridge.field.clues.steep_readi: Narrow drop · %s blocks below the banks
slate.starbridge.field.sight.mark: Look for a passage beside the brick. Stand at its entrance and record the site on your field map.
slate.starbridge.field.sight.aim: Close the chart, find a secure place on the rim and aim at an exposed wall. Open this view to compare the face.
slate.starbridge.field.walking_legend: Lines mark height changes of 2+ blocks. Look for gaps or point at a cell to read its height.
slate.starbridge.field.legend: Orange marks hollows. Gold rims mark narrow drops. Dark cells are unsurveyed.
slate.starbridge.field.moved: Terminal moved. Hold the original terminal and reopen its survey.
slate.starbridge.field.world: World changed. Reopen the survey in this world.
slate.starbridge.supply.assembler.help: Place the coal generator beside the rocket assembler. Press %s on the generator, put coal in its fuel slot, then check the assembler’s RF reading.
slate.starbridge.machine.missing: The installed controller has no readable assembly plan.
slate.starbridge.machine.help: Build from the bottom up. Select a cell to see one accepted part.
slate.starbridge.bucket.water_help: Put a water bucket into the electrolyser input. Pick up the empty bucket.
slate.starbridge.bucket.take_gas_help: Use an empty bucket in each electrolyser outlet when it holds a full bucket of gas.
slate.starbridge.bucket.feed_gas_help: Empty the two different gas buckets into separate reactor inputs. Take back each empty bucket.
slate.starbridge.bucket.take_fuel_help: Put an empty bucket into the reactor outlet. Pick up the original rocket fuel bucket.
slate.starbridge.propellant.power: Supply power and turn on both original controllers using their power switches.
slate.starbridge.propellant.title: Make rocket propellant
slate.starbridge.propellant.missing: The server has no matching fluid-only recipe for this machine.
slate.starbridge.propellant.transfer: Feed the two output fluids into separate fluid inputs on the chemical reactor. Use the original holographic projector to view each machine structure.
slate.starbridge.propellant.collect: Collect the output in the original fuel bucket. Use it at the assembler after your rocket is assembled.
slate.starbridge.supply.propellant.help: After assembly, hold an original rocket-fuel bucket and stand beside the rocket. Press %s on the assembler, choose Fuel and check the mB actually loaded.
slate.starbridge.supply.helm.help: Hold furnace fuel such as charcoal and press %s on your own helm to charge its drive, or connect FE. The star map shows flight cost and the return reserve.
slate.starbridge.supply.missing: The original parts marked with a question mark are absent from this world. Check the installed upstream mods and libraries.
